assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin B uses subject "admin-b" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Tile fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And Category 101 has label "category-a" and Import Map 201 has Module Name "container-a"
4. And both references belong to "FMO_ADMIN" and the Tile page category filter value is Category 101
5. And the Tile grid has record "301" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
6. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Name" as "tile-081"
7. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Path" as "/fixture"
8. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Path" as "/case-081"
9. And the baseline fixture data defines "Role Entities" as "E-TRADE"
10. And the baseline fixture data defines "Filter Rule" as ""
11. And the baseline Tile references use "Aplication Category" "category-a" and "Container" "container-a"
12. And Tile record "301" is inactive when this browser loads its grid
15. When Admin B clicks the button labeled "Verify" in the Tile grid row with "Record Id" "301"
16. Then the dialog titled "verify ID: 301" is visible on the Tile administration page
17. When Admin B clicks the button labeled "Verified" in dialog "verify ID: 301"
18. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed message for an inactive-reference error
